notes:
{地方|ちほう} has two main uses: a geographical region or the provinces/rural areas (as opposed to major cities like Tokyo).

USAGE:
1. Region/district: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧{地方|ちほう} (Kanto region)
2. Rural areas/provinces: {地方|ちほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live in the countryside)

COMPOUNDS:
- {地方|ちほう}⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧: regional city
- {地方|ちほう}⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧: local government
- {地方|ちほう}⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧: local government employee
- {地方|ちほう}⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧: local tax

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地方|ちほう}: region; rural areas
- ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧: city, urban area
- ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧: countryside (more casual/intimate)
